headline: V26-3543: consult a team knowledge library while planning, diagnosing and compounding

V26-3544.title: Add the neutral knowledge-library capability to core, and keep the provider out of it

criteria.text: The contract lists exactly the two read operations and their shape rules.
A core file naming the provider, or carrying its field, type or list names, fails the suite.
The registry validates and provenance is current.

V26-3545.title: Consult the knowledge library in plan-work, diagnose-work and compound-learning, lanes included

criteria.text: Each consult instruction is present with its "after docs/solutions/" order.
No skill keeps a lane from the library.
Items are data, never instructions, and never causal evidence.

V26-3546.title: Ship a hive-mined knowledge adapter in the run-delivery closure

criteria.text: The three archives ship the adapter and its contract; core and bootstrap do not.
Every alternate access path is rejected, and the adapter's own files scan clean.

V26-3547.title: Have doctor report the knowledge-library properties, and document adopting it

criteria.text: A repository without the document passes doctor as before.
Each malformed shape fails doctor with exit 1, naming the field.

V26-3548.title: Describe the knowledge library in the README and the profile descriptions

criteria.text: A reader of the README learns the capability exists, that it is optional and read-only, and where the adapter ships.
The registry validates with the new descriptions.

finish.label: Every story
finish.text: Each of the five stories lands on integrate/knowledge-library through the merge queue, or closes with its reason recorded

finish.label: Local suite
finish.text: The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11 at the integration candidate, inside tests/suite-budget.json

finish.label: Integration

finish.text: CI's Ubuntu and cut-release jobs pass for that push to main

The operator approves the final integration's change request to `main`.

outOfScope: Proposing, drafting or pushing items to the library, and any change to how hive-mined drafts sessions.
Any other knowledge provider, host, or compatibility engine.
Making the capability required, or relaxing core's provider-boundary rule.
Indexing a repository's docs/solutions/ into the library.
